name: dovetail
title: Dovetail
description: For carpenters and joiners: every card and page heading is a walnut bar locked into a pale maple board by a row of dovetails, prices are stamped on the face in slab figures like a timber-yard mark, and the rules are the striped edge of birch plywood.

tokens.--font-slab: headings, the business name, card titles, phone numbers, stamped prices and dates, prices in tables (a slab serif, like a tool-maker's stamp)
tokens.--font-body: body text, the menu and small labels (a humanist sans)
tokens.--text-s: small text: labels, table headings, quote attributions, the footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size, the business name and the small slab links
tokens.--text-l: card titles and board headings, the standfirst, stamped prices on cards, customer quotes, the phone number in the header
tokens.--text-xl: section headings in page text, the stamped price on a service page, the phone number in the call block and on the home page call button
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles on the walnut bar
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of capital labels and of the business name
tokens.--color-panel: the pale face of page headings, cards, the checklist and the call block (maple), the pins between their tails, the ground of code, and the lettering on the home page call button
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings in page text, the business name, the menu, the line under table headings (graphite pencil)
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: small labels, table headings, quote attributions, the page count, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: walnut used as ink: stamped prices and dates with their frame, prices in tables, checklist ticks, list bullets, the tail under the current menu item
tokens.--color-link: links, phone and e-mail links, the arrow on a card, the call button on the home page, and the focus ring (chalk-line blue)
tokens.--color-walnut: the walnut bars and their tails: page headings, card titles, board headings
tokens.--color-on-walnut: lettering on the walnut bars, and the focus ring there
tokens.--color-line: pencil hairlines: the outline of page headings, cards, boards and code blocks, the lines between table rows, the shade at the edge of a table that scrolls
tokens.--color-ply-light: the pale plies in the plywood-edge rule
tokens.--color-ply-dark: the dark plies in the plywood-edge rule (under the header, above the footer, beside a customer quote, a rule in page text)
tokens.--page-width: widest the page column may get
tokens.--measure: widest a column of page text may get
tokens.--card-min: narrowest a card may get before the grid drops a column, and the narrowest the side column may get
tokens.--gutter: space at the left and right of the page, which is also how far a page-heading bar runs past the column
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between list items, between a label and its heading
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside the walnut bars, between menu links, in table cells
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: padding inside cards, between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between cards and between stacked boards
tokens.--space-5: gap between sections, and between the text and the side column
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the price stamp, the call button and inline code
tokens.--rule: thickness of the stamp frame, link underlines, checklist ticks and the line under table headings; the focus ring and the card arrows are one pixel thicker
tokens.--joint-pitch: distance from one tail to the next on a card, about five tails to a card (page headings use a larger multiple on wide screens)
tokens.--joint-depth: height of the row of tails on a card
tokens.--joint-neck: half the width of a pin where it meets the walnut bar; larger means wider pins and slimmer tails
tokens.--joint-angle: how far the sides of the tails lean from upright
tokens.--ply-layer: thickness of one ply in the plywood-edge rule, which is five plies thick
